module.name: Recipe Book
module.author: Demo
module.description: A recipe management app showcasing the Jinja2 database template system (render_db_template). Browse, search, and view detailed recipes with a warm food-themed design. Templates are stored in the database and rendered via stored Jinja2 templates with loops, conditionals, and filters.

scripts.script:
from app.models import Template Recipe = DynamicModel.get_or_create('recipe_book', { 'title': db.String(200), 'author': db.String(100), 'cuisine': db.String(50), 'ingredients': db.Text, 'instructions': db.Text, 'prep_time': db.Integer, 'cook_time': db.Integer, 'difficulty': db.String(20), 'rating': db.Integer, 'image_url': db.Text, }) if not session.query(Recipe).first(): seed = [ { 'title': 'Spaghetti Carbonara', 'author': 'Maria Rossi', 'cuisine': 'Italian', 'ingredients': '400g spaghetti, 200g pancetta or guanciale, 4 large egg yolks, 100g Pecorino Romano, freshly cracked black pepper, 2 cloves garlic, 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, sea salt', 'instructions': '1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil. Cook spaghetti until al dente, about 1 minute less than package directions. Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining.\n2. While pasta cooks, cut pancetta into small cubes. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds, then remove and discard.\n3. Add pancetta to the skillet. Cook until golden and crispy, 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat.\n4. In a bowl, whisk egg yolks with grated Pecorino and a generous amount of black pepper until smooth.\n5. Add hot drained pasta to the pancetta skillet (off heat). Toss to coat in the rendered fat.\n6. Pour the egg mixture over the pasta and toss vigorously for 2 minutes. The residual heat will create a silky sauce. Add pasta water a splash at a time if needed.\n7. Serve immediately with extra Pecorino and black pepper on top.', 'prep_time': 10, 'cook_time': 20, 'difficulty': 'Medium', 'rating': 5, 'image_url': '', }, { 'title': 'Chicken Tacos al Pastor', 'author': 'Carlos Mendez', 'cuisine': 'Mexican', 'ingredients': '800g boneless chicken thighs, 3 dried guajillo chiles, 2 chipotle peppers in adobo, 3 cloves garlic, 1/2 cup pineapple juice, 2 tbsp apple cider vinegar, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp oregano, corn tortillas, diced onion, fresh cilantro, lime wedges, pineapple slices', 'instructions': '1. Toast guajillo chiles in a dry skillet until fragrant, about 1 minute per side. Remove stems and seeds, then soak in hot water for 15 minutes.\n2. Blend soaked guajillos with chipotle peppers, garlic, pineapple juice, vinegar, cumin, and oregano until smooth to make the marinade.\n3. Cut chicken into thin strips. Coat thoroughly with the marinade. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours, preferably overnight.\n4. Cook chicken on a very hot grill or cast iron skillet with pineapple slices, working in batches. Cook until charred and cooked through, about 4 minutes per side.\n5. Chop the grilled chicken and pineapple into small pieces.\n6. Warm corn tortillas on the grill or in a dry skillet.\n7. Assemble tacos with chicken, pineapple, diced onion, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime.', 'prep_time': 30, 'cook_time': 15, 'difficulty': 'Medium', 'rating': 5, 'image_url': '', }, { 'title': 'Miso Glazed Salmon', 'author': 'Yuki Tanaka', 'cuisine': 'Japanese', 'ingredients': '4 salmon fillets (170g each), 3 tbsp white miso paste, 2 tbsp mirin, 1 tbsp sake, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil, sliced scallions, toasted sesame seeds, steamed rice for serving', 'instructions': '1. Whisk together miso paste, mirin, sake, sugar, rice vinegar, and sesame oil in a small bowl until smooth.\n2. Pat salmon fillets dry with paper towels. Place in a shallow dish and spread the miso glaze generously over the top and sides. Marinate for at least 30 minutes (up to 24 hours in the fridge).\n3. Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.\n4. Place salmon skin-side down on the prepared baking sheet. Reserve any remaining glaze.\n5. Bake for 12-15 minutes until the salmon flakes easily with a fork and the glaze is caramelized and bubbly.\n6. Optional: broil for the last 2 minutes for extra caramelization. Watch carefully to avoid burning.\n7. Serve over steamed rice, garnished with scallions and sesame seeds.', 'prep_time': 40, 'cook_time': 15, 'difficulty': 'Easy', 'rating': 4, 'image_url': '', }, { 'title': 'Butter Chicken', 'author': 'Priya Sharma', 'cuisine': 'Indian', 'ingredients': '800g boneless chicken thighs, 1 cup plain yogurt, 2 tbsp lemon juice, 2 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chili powder, 4 tbsp butter, 1 large onion (diced), 4 cloves garlic (minced), 1 inch ginger (grated), 1 can crushed tomatoes (400g), 1 cup heavy cream, 1 tsp sugar, fresh cilantro, salt to taste, basmati rice or naan', 'instructions': '1. Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces. Marinate in yogurt, lemon juice, 1 tsp garam masala, turmeric, cumin, and chili powder for at least 1 hour.\n2. Heat 2 tbsp butter in a large pan over high heat. Cook chicken pieces in batches until browned on all sides, about 3 minutes per batch. Set aside.\n3. In the same pan, melt remaining 2 tbsp butter. Sauté onion until soft and golden, about 5 minutes.\n4. Add garlic and ginger, cook for 1 minute until fragrant.\n5. Add crushed tomatoes, sugar, and remaining garam masala. Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.\n6. Stir in heavy cream and add the cooked chicken back to the pan. Simmer for another 10 minutes.\n7. Adjust seasoning with salt. Garnish generously with fresh cilantro.\n8. Serve hot with basmati rice or warm naan bread.', 'prep_time': 20, 'cook_time': 40, 'difficulty': 'Medium', 'rating': 5, 'image_url': '', }, { 'title': 'French Onion Soup', 'author': 'Pierre Dumont', 'cuisine': 'French', 'ingredients': '6 large yellow onions (thinly sliced), 60g butter, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp sugar, 1/2 cup dry white wine, 6 cups beef broth, 2 sprigs fresh thyme, 1 bay leaf, 4 thick slices crusty baguette, 200g Gruyère cheese (grated), salt and freshly ground black pepper', 'instructions': '1. Melt butter with olive oil in a large heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat. Add all the sliced onions and stir to coat.\n2. Cook onions on medium-low heat, stirring every few minutes, for 40-50 minutes until deeply caramelized and jammy. Do not rush this step. Add sugar halfway through to help caramelize.\n3. Pour in white wine and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom. Cook until the wine is mostly evaporated.\n4. Add beef broth, thyme, and bay leaf. Bring to a simmer and cook for 20 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.\n5. Preheat broiler. Ladle soup into oven-safe crocks placed on a baking sheet.\n6. Place a toasted baguette slice on top of each crock. Pile generously with grated Gruyère.\n7. Broil for 3-5 minutes until the cheese is melted, bubbly, and golden brown.\n8. Let cool slightly before serving — the crocks will be extremely hot.', 'prep_time': 15, 'cook_time': 75, 'difficulty': 'Medium', 'rating': 4, 'image_url': '', }, { 'title': 'Classic Smashed Burgers', 'author': 'Jake Thompson', 'cuisine': 'American', 'ingredients': '500g ground beef (80/20 blend), 4 potato buns, 4 slices American cheese, 1 cup shredded iceberg lettuce, 2 ripe tomatoes (sliced), 1 red onion (thinly sliced), dill pickles (sliced), ketchup, yellow mustard, mayonnaise, butter for toasting buns, salt and pepper', 'instructions': '1. Divide ground beef into 4 equal portions. Form into loose balls — do not overwork the meat. Season generously with salt and pepper on all sides.\n2. Heat a cast iron skillet over high heat until screaming hot. Add a thin film of oil.\n3. Place a beef ball on the skillet. Immediately smash it flat with a sturdy spatula, pressing firmly for 10 seconds. Season the top with salt and pepper.\n4. Cook without moving for 3 minutes until a deep brown crust forms. Flip, add a slice of cheese immediately, and cook for another 1-2 minutes.\n5. While burgers cook, butter the cut sides of the buns and toast them on a separate skillet until golden.\n6. Spread mayonnaise on the bottom bun, add shredded lettuce, then the burger patty, tomato, onion, pickles, mustard, and ketchup.\n7. Crown with the top bun and serve immediately with crinkle-cut fries.', 'prep_time': 10, 'cook_time': 10, 'difficulty': 'Easy', 'rating': 4, 'image_url': '', }, ] for r in seed: recipe = Recipe(**r) session.add(recipe) session.commit() recipe_id = request.args.get('id', type=int) query = request.args.get('q', '', type=str).strip() if recipe_id: tpl = Template.query.filter_by(name='recipe_detail', module_id=module_id).first() recipe = session.query(Recipe).get(recipe_id) if not recipe: _result = render('
